design.warmup: one untimed admission run per side (A then B), then one untimed warm-up run per side in the opposite order (B then A), so each side has run twice in this browser before timing starts
design.isolation: one browser process for the session, a fresh context per run

environment.hostIdle: not controlled: other processes (including other agents) may run on this machine during the session
environment.power: not available: power settings are not read by this harness
